newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady to soft awaits gasoline boost.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady to soft awaits gasoline boost.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were steady to softer in quiet trade on Friday. Traders said business was restricted to end-user top-up buying interest and the market was still waiting for a seasonal boost from gasoline.
"Recent strength in the Far East pulled the market up but it's gone about as far as it can go until the spring gasoline season kicks in," one trader said.

Traders said arbitrage to the East and West was the focus of cargo trade but no fresh sales were reported in either direction despite a notional softening in European full cargo prices as buyers and sellers held apart.
Prompt cargoes valued around 50 cents lower at $197.50 a tonne cif NWE. April swaps firmed $1-2 to talk around $203/$205 a tonne cif NWE.
Barge prices edged up on the back of end-user buying interest for small parcels, but trade stayed thin.
